onboarding.welcome_text: WaseBoard is a shared soundboard for Discord: click a sound and it plays both on your speakers and in your voice channel, for everyone.
onboarding.server_intro: The sound catalog and the Discord bot that plays them are hosted on a server — not provided with the app, each group hosts its own.
onboarding.server_invited: If someone invited you: ask the person who hosts for the address and token. Otherwise:
onboarding.address_tooltip: E.g. https://my-server.example — ask whoever hosts your WaseBoard server
onboarding.discord_intro: Lets WaseBoard show your avatar when you play a sound, and automatically find the right voice channel.
onboarding.discord_bot: A Discord bot (added to the Discord server by whoever hosts) joins your voice channel and plays the sounds — never through your microphone. Once connected, type “/join” in Discord (or use the “🔊 Join my voice channel” button in WaseBoard) to make the bot join you.
onboarding.reason.deeplink: You just clicked a WaseBoard connection link — finish by signing in with Discord below.
onboarding.reason.server_changed: Your WaseBoard server has changed address or access token — update your settings below, or go to Settings > Updates if you use the default server.
onboarding.reason.expired: Your Discord connection has expired — sign in again to continue.
onboarding.mode_default: You are connected by default to the free public WaseBoard instance — all that is left is to sign in with Discord in the next step.
onboarding.mode_own_server: To use it, you need a WaseBoard server — the one of the person who introduced you to the app (ask them for the address and access token), or your own. Two small steps to connect; you can always come back to them from Settings.
onboarding.test.no_voice: ✅ Server reachable and token accepted — but the bot doesn't see you in any voice channel right now (normal if you aren't connected to Discord / in a channel where the bot is present).
